name: Select Technology Inc
old_description: We will serve you as a valuable link in your supply chain, offering worldwide access to OEM, CEM and distributor inventories.
about:
Select Technology Inc is based in Rowley, Massachusetts, where it operates as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company serves as a link in the supply chain, offering worldwide access to OEM, contract electronics manufacturer (CEM), and distributor inventories.

The distributor maintains over 10,000 line items in its on-site inventory and provides a range of value-added services including bill-of-materials analysis, microscopic inspection, solderability testing, de-lidding (destructive physical analysis), x-ray analysis, product programming, tape-and-reeling, dry packing, and baking. Its warehouse is fully ESD and MSD compliant per IPC/JEDEC J-STD-033A, and its incoming quality-control team averages 20 years of experience in electronic component inspection.

Select Technology’s customer base includes direct manufacturers and representatives, Fortune 500 OEMs and CEMs, independent distributors, and franchise distributors. The company holds AS9120:2016 certification, indicating a focus on aerospace and defense supply chains, alongside ISO 9001:2015 and ANSI/ESD S20.20-2021.

The company emphasizes its experienced staff—account managers average more than 10 years in electronic distribution—and offers 24/7 availability, a dedicated customer portal for full supply-chain visibility, and a counterfeit prevention process that combines visual inspection, electrical testing, and third-party laboratory analysis. Same-day shipping is available for stocked parts.
